observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a white game console body with a diamond-vent pattern and an Xbox logo on the top-left corner, consistent with the Xbox One S shape.
The console is wrapped in clear plastic and held by a hand near a shop window; no price tag, serial sticker, or model number is visible.
No power adapter, HDMI cable, controller, or retail box is visible in either photo.
The side of the unit that would show a disc-drive slot (to confirm 'disc-free' All-Digital Edition) is not clearly visible in either shot.
No screen-on or boot-up shot is shown, so functional state cannot be judged.
Background shows unrelated stock (hard drives, other gadgets) suggesting a general electronics resale shop, not a dedicated gaming store.
